---
title: "Data representations and operators"
format: html
---

`sblr` has three canonical operator families.

| Operator | Data level | Practical input |
|---|---|---|
| `packed_bed` | individual | selected PLINK BED genotypes and phenotypes |
| `csr` | summary statistics | `wy`, `ww`, sample metadata, and disk-backed sparse LD correlations |
| `block_eigen` | summary statistics | scalar retained factors by default; historical reconstructed dense blocks explicitly; aligned scores, reference BED data, and block settings |

Packed-BED routes decode selected markers once and use the actual standardized
analysis-genotype variance. CSR stores retained upper-triangle off-diagonal
correlations with an implicit unit correlation diagonal; the sampler combines
those values with aligned `stats$ww` marker cross-products. Scalar block eigen
defaults to rectangular retained factors selected by 99.5% cumulative positive
eigenvalue mass. `representation = "dense_reconstructed"` preserves the old
packed reconstruction and its absolute-threshold/ridge policies. The low-rank
route stores retained rectangular factors and reduced residuals; only the
historical route stores reconstructed dense block upper triangles.

The retained route follows the GCTB/SBayesRC eigenspace likelihood strategy in
`sblr` cross-product units. Its retained-rank rule, transformed score, and
marker conditionals have a scale crosswalk to GCTB, while residual variance
uses `sblr`'s global projected contract rather than GCTB's block-specific
variance procedure.

Marker identity, order, allele orientation, scale, and sample/frequency
provenance matter more than matching dimensions. External GWAS summary
statistics and reference-panel LD describe different populations unless that
relationship is explicitly justified. Record the summary population, LD
reference population, selected samples/markers, allele alignment, frequencies,
and thresholds.

The LD representation is part of the fitted likelihood, not only a storage
choice. Complete aligned cross-products can support an exact summary-data
likelihood, whereas thresholded/windowed CSR and retained block eigen define
different approximations. See
[How LD representation changes summary-statistics BLR](summary_ld_operator_interpretation.qmd)
for operator integrity, fidelity, study interpretation, and a pre-fit checklist.

See [Sparse-LD workflows](sparse_ld_workflows.qmd) for construction,
[Sparse-LD CSR methods](../methods/sparse_ld_csr.qmd) for the disk/operator
contract, and [Block-eigen methods](../methods/block_eigen_operator.qmd) for
filter and runtime-diagonal semantics.
